theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

top_news.title: Outsiders Pay $6,500 for Help With Sorority Rush
top_news.summary: The push by young women to gain acceptance into sororities at large schools in the Deep South has led to an increase in demand for rush coaches. Bloomberg News Reporter Gabriel Baumgaertner discusses his recent story about the high price tag some parents are willing to invest to help their kids get into the sorority of their dreams. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Trump Touts $3B in Mineral Project to Counter China
top_news.summary: During a recent meeting with top industry executives, the US President announced $3 billion in investments aimed at strengthening the domestic critical minerals and mining sector. The initiative seeks to reduce reliance on supply chains dominated by China. Gary Evans, Chairman and CEO of US Antimony, participated in the discussion and spoke to Bloomberg News about how much he is willing to see the government invest in his firm. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Gautam Adani Wins Dismissal of US Securities Fraud Charges
top_news.summary: Gautam Adani won dismissal of US securities fraud charges, ending a blockbuster case that threatened the expansion of the Indian billionaire’s giant conglomerate.

top_news.title: JBS Returns Leadership to Batista Clan as Scion Named CEO
top_news.summary: The world’s largest meat supplier, JBS NV, will be led once again by a member of Brazil’s Batista family, a pivotal move for a global food powerhouse that’s increasingly focused on the US.

top_news.title: AI Stock Heavy ETF Risks Spread to Broader Equity Market
top_news.summary: A growing share of equity leverage is riding on the same AI names, many of which have seen historic swings.

top_news.title: Gotham Greens CEO: Not Good To Have an Outbreak Like This
top_news.summary: Craig Stevenson, CEO of Gotham Greens, addressed the ongoing concerns over food safety amid recent recalls linked to salmonella in jalapenos and the widespread Cyclospora outbreak affecting thousands in the U.S. He noted a temporary decline in consumer demand for greens as news of outbreaks circulates, but emphasized that consumer interest in salads remains strong. He speaks with David Gura & Isabelle Lee on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: ETFs Look Safer After Bitcoin Hack, Small Caps | ETF IQ 8/10/2026
top_news.summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: JPMorgan Investment Management Chief ETF Strategist Jon Maier, BlackRock Head of Digital Assets Robert Mitchnick, Avantis Investors CIO Eduardo Repetto, and Raymond James Vice President of ETF Strategy Mayuranki De. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: US Stocks End Mixed as Chipmaker Earnings, CPI Due to Set Pace
top_news.summary: US stocks held steady through Monday’s market close after a strong earnings week as investors continue to navigate the uncertain path of interest rates and war in Iran. The market is gearing up for the final stretch of corporate earnings, with chipmakers set to provide confirmation for the long-winded debate over valuations.

top_news.title: Oil Jumps as Markets Await Middle East Clarity | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with David Gura, Isabelle Lee, Norah Mulinda and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Strategy Sells More Bitcoin, Stock to Bolster Cash Stockpile
